releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.description:
## Highlights

### 🔀 Renamed to “Prompt template” + a proper on/off toggle
The **Review preamble** setting is now **Prompt template**, and it has its own **toggle** — flip it off to generate the plain review note without clearing your text, then flip it back on to bring it back. No more emptying the field to disable it.

Your saved text migrates automatically: a `reviewPreamble` from 0.4.0 is carried over to the new `promptTemplate` on first load, so nothing is lost.

### 📝 Prompt template (recap)
When the toggle is on, every generated note leads with your template — a fill-in-the-blank scaffold plus an LLM prompt, ready to complete and paste. Placeholders substituted at generation time:

| Placeholder        | Renders as                                  |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------------------- |
| `{{time}}`         | current time, e.g. `3:42 PM`                |
| `{{date}}`         | today, e.g. `Sunday, July 27, 2026`         |
| `{{window}}`       | the window's label, e.g. `7 days`           |
| `{{window_start}}` | the date the window opened (`now − window`) |

Edit it in **Settings → Community plugins → Microlite → Template**.

## Install / update
Community-plugin users update in place from **Settings → Community plugins**. Or download `main.js`, `manifest.json`, and `styles.css` below into `<vault>/.obsidian/plugins/microlite/`.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/jaanaltosaar/obsidian-microlite/compare/0.4.0...0.5.0

releases.description:
## Highlights

### 📝 Configurable review preamble
Every generated note can now lead with a **review preamble** — a fill-in-the-blank scaffold plus an LLM prompt, so the note is ready to complete and paste. Obsidian's own Templates can't run a plugin command, so Microlite bakes this in instead.

Four placeholders are substituted at generation time:

| Placeholder        | Renders as                                  |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------------------- |
| `{{time}}`         | current time, e.g. `3:42 PM`                |
| `{{date}}`         | today, e.g. `Sunday, July 27, 2026`         |
| `{{window}}`       | the window's label, e.g. `7 days`           |
| `{{window_start}}` | the date the window opened (`now − window`) |

It ships with a journaling + Acceptance-and-Commitment-Therapy default. Edit it — or clear it for a plain review note — in **Settings → Community plugins → Microlite → Review preamble**.

### 🩺 Clearer failure messages
When generation fails, the notice now shows the **actual error message** (with the full stack still in the console) instead of a generic "see console."

### 📖 Docs
- Documented the review preamble and its placeholders in the README.
- Added a contact line for issues and feedback: **jaan.li@jaan.li**.
- Trimmed the duplicated long catalog description.

## Install / update
Community-plugin users update in place from **Settings → Community plugins**. Or download `main.js`, `manifest.json`, and `styles.css` below into `<vault>/.obsidian/plugins/microlite/`.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/jaanaltosaar/obsidian-microlite/compare/0.3.0...0.4.0

releases.description:
Initial release of Microlite.

Turn Obsidian's File Recovery history into an LLM-ready review of what you've been writing: one dated note with a per-day activity table and heading-aware diffs (newest first), bulk-sync detection, rename tracking, live-content folding, and opened-but-unchanged notes dropped. Desktop and mobile; no network requests.
